title: banksia prolata
intro: Banksia prolata, commonly known as Quandong Banksia, is a plant species native to Western Australia, characterized by its distinctive cone-shaped flowers and edible fruits. The fruits of the Banksia prolata plant have been traditionally used to promote digestive health, with its health benefits including relief from constipation and other gastrointestinal issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion and alleviate symptoms associated with irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of Banksia prolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
